in_sanskrit.name: Jetikā
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings victory, triumphant

in_marathi.name: Jetika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Durga's victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jetika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jetika is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jayati' meaning 'victorious' and 'Ikha' meaning 'one'. This name signifies the victory of the Goddess Durga over evil forces. In Hindu mythology, Durga is worshipped as the mother of the universe and the protector of all beings.
